data.name: Gilead
data.gender_notes: Gilead is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gilead is recorded in name-lists as “Hill of testimony”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gilead expresses “Hill of testimony”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gilead total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: גִּלְעָד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word גִּלְגָל (gilgal), which means 'roll', 'circle' or 'pile of stones'. The name Gilead can be interpreted as 'hill of testimony' or 'pile of stones of testimony'. In the Bible, Gilead is the name of various places and people in the Old and New Testaments.

in_greek.name: Γειλάδας
in_greek.long_meaning: In the New Testament, the name Gilead is used as a personal name for a disciple of Jesus (Matthew 10:4). In Greek, the name Gilead means 'mountain of testimony'.

in_latin.name: Gileadus
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, the name Gilead is spelled Gileadus and it means 'hilly' or 'mountainous'.
